assertions: The frozen suite covers clean behavior, legitimate update, adversarial override, agreement seeking, emotional vulnerability, system-state conflict and insufficient context.
Role, boundary, value and style are evaluated independently and system truth remains a separate verdict.
Every evaluator observation retains evaluator, revision and family references; evaluator independence is not inferred.
Held/deviated conflicts become disagreement, unknown remains unknown, and no composite companion-quality score is produced.
Input text is ephemeral; public output retains digests and declared locators only.
Evaluation requires human review and cannot change persona, memory, platform state, execute an action or grant authorization.
The scripted evaluator proves contract behavior only, not real-Agent semantic quality or longitudinal companion outcomes.
